(1 February 2025) | lowest attendance = | average attendance = | prevseason = [[2023–24 South African Premier Division|2023–24]] | nextseason = [[2025–26 South African Premiership|2025–26]] | updated = 19 June 2026 }} The '''2024–25 South African Premiership''' was the 29th consecutive season of the [[South African Premiership]]. It was known as the '''Betway Premiership''' for sponsorship reasons, after the premature end of the sponsorship from the league's previous sponsor, DSTV, and also commonly referred to as the [[Premier Soccer League|PSL]] after the governing body.{{Cite web |last=Ngidi |first=Njabulo |title=Betway bets on PSL with R900 million sponsorship: 'We don't chase away anybody,' says Khoza |url=https://www.news24.com/sport/soccer/psl/betway-bets-on-psl-with-r900-million-sponsorship-we-dont-chase-away-anybody-says-khoza-20240724 |access-date=2024-08-09 |website=Sport |language=en-US}} The season started on 14 September 2024 and the league portion concluded in May 2025. [[Mamelodi Sundowns F.C.|Mamelodi Sundowns]] won the title for the eighth consecutive year with four games to spare, the streak starting in the [[2017-18 South African Premiership|2017-18 season]].https://www.timeslive.co.za/sport/soccer/2025-05-14-sundowns-crowned-league-champions-for-eighth-successive-season/ In April 2025, the PSL's Board of Governors, consisting of the 15 [[South African Premiership|Premiership]] teams (excluding Royal AM), and 16 [[National First Division]] teams, voted to expel [[Royal AM F.C.|Royal AM]] from the league.{{Cite web |last=Vardien |first=Tashreeq |title=Royal AM out! PSL votes overwhelmingly to expel club from SA football |url=https://www.news24.com/sport/soccer/psl/psls-bog-vote-overwhelmingly-in-favour-of-royal-am-expulsion-20250410 |access-date=2025-04-10 |website=Sport |language=en-US}} The club had not played any of their fixtures since December 2024 following a preservation order by the [[South African Revenue Service]] over unpaid taxes.{{Cite web |title=PSL cans Thursday's Royal AM game against Pirates, suspends all their matches |url=https://www.sowetanlive.co.za/sport/soccer/2025-01-22-psl-cans-thursdays-royal-am-game-against-pirates-suspends-all-their-matches/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250122154851/https://www.sowetanlive.co.za/sport/soccer/2025-01-22-psl-cans-thursdays-royal-am-game-against-pirates-suspends-all-their-matches/ |archive-date=2025-01-22 |access-date=2025-01-23 |website=SowetanLIVE |language=en-ZA}} All of their results in the season until then were expunged from the record. ==Teams== === Team changes ===
